title: Investigating Responsible AI for Scientific Research: An Empirical Study

bias_targets.methodology: A mixed-methods approach utilizing surveys and in-depth interviews to measure AI practitioners' overall awareness, understanding, and implementation practices regarding bias detection, data representativeness, and fairness in scientific AI projects.

Qualitative evaluation through practitioner interviews identifying fairness concerns regarding smaller, under-resourced entities (e.g., small farms) being disadvantaged by or underrepresented in AI systems compared to well-resourced entities.

Qualitative assessment via interviews with AI project teams highlighting the need to include diverse geographical distributions in training data to prevent AI systems from giving unfair advantages to specific geographical areas.
